# Web Doctor Development

- Build MCP behavior with the official TypeScript server SDK: https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/typescript-sdk
- Follow the MCP server guide for tools, resources, prompts, and stdio transport: https://ts.sdk.modelcontextprotocol.io/v2/
- Keep stdout reserved for MCP JSON-RPC while the stdio server is running; write diagnostics to stderr.
- Keep project inspection read-only unless a later approved capability explicitly says otherwise.
